newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eridania sees oper profit flat to higher.
newsitem.headline: Eridania sees oper profit flat to higher.

text.p: The chairman of Eridania Beghin-Say forecast on Friday that the food group's operating profit would be stable to slightly higher for 1997.
Chairman Stefano Meloni earlier said results would be flat to higher at a news conference, but he told reporters afterwards that he was referring to operating profit.
"I see operating profit stable, possibly slightly higher," Meloni said.
He also said he expected turnover to increase in 1997 at the same rate as in 1996. Turnover in 1996 was up 8.2 percent to 54.98 billion francs ($9.8 billion).
Operating profit fell 6.2 percent to 3.75 billion francs in 1996.
Asked about his forecast for net profit, Meloni said, "I don't think it could drop this year".
